Chapter 658: Chapter 5 Pushing You Forward (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)_3

Chapter 658: Chapter 5 Pushing You Forward (5000 words, please subscribe)_3

But at this moment, Lin Yuan’s performance had given Xia Qin Supreme Being a glimpse of hope—

the hope that Lin Yuan had grasped the Rule of Time while being a Ninth Rank.

“You should know, the earlier you comprehend the Rule of Time, making your inner world ‘independent,’ the greater the benefits,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being began.

“Right.”

“I know this.”

...

Lin Yuan nodded.

In the history of human civilization, there were occasionally freaks who understood the Rule of Time at the Tenth Rank.

That’s why Lin Yuan knew that comprehending the Rule of Time at the Tenth Rank, then advancing to Tier 11, would reap much greater benefits than not comprehending it, with the inner world undergoing a transformation.

As for comprehending the Rule of Time at the Ninth Rank? There were no corresponding cases in the history of human civilization, but that did not prevent Lin Yuan from speculating.

If comprehending the Rule of Time at the Tenth Rank would provide an additional opportunity for transformation of the inner world, then doing so at the Ninth Rank would surely offer two additional opportunities upon advancing to the Tenth and Eleventh Ranks, wouldn’t it?

“Then do you know what specific benefits are, and why the inner world undergoes a transformation?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being asked, smiling.

“I don’t know.” Lin Yuan shook his head.

He was only aware of the benefits, but not what they specifically were.

The information he had accessed did not elaborate, likely involving some secretive aspects of human civilization.

Even Eighth Rank citizenship access wasn’t sufficient to view it all.

“Well, we need to talk about the breakthrough from the Tenth Rank to Eleventh Rank of an Evolver, and what difference it makes whether the inner world is ‘independent’ or not,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being said, pausing briefly before continuing:

“If a Tenth Rank Evolver has not comprehended the Rule of Time, the inner world lacks a temporal pillar and is dependent on the Main Universe, remaining merely an affiliated world.”

“Affiliated worlds, when undergoing a Great Realm breakthrough, communicate with the Origin Sea of the Main Universe; at that time, the Main Universe will actively open the entrance to the Origin Sea, pouring a massive amount of Origin Power to help the inner world grow rapidly.”

“However, if the inner world is already ‘independent,’ possessing a temporal pillar and also a spatial pillar, it can be considered an ‘independent’ world.”

“Even if this ‘independent’ world is insignificant compared to the Main Universe, it is still ‘independent’ and theoretically at the same tier as the Main Universe.”

“Possessing separate pillars of time and space.”

“Hence, when such ‘independent’ worlds go through a Great Realm breakthrough, they are not receiving the origin from the Main Universe but the origin from the Chaos Void.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan.

“So that’s how it is,” Lin Yuan mused thoughtfully.

The Chaos Void, no doubt more vast than the universe, makes its origin more precious than that of the universe.

If ranked from highest to lowest, it would definitely be the Chaos Void above the universe above the affiliated world.

Once an affiliated world becomes temporally and spatially independent, it will stand equal to the universe, jointly receiving gifts from the Chaos Void.

Typically, most supremes can only dream of receiving gifts from the Chaos Void when they strive for the Ultimate Being at Tier 11.

Because understanding the Rule of Time usually happens at this tier.

The gifts and transformations that only supremes enjoy could be experienced at the Tenth Rank; imagine how significant the assistance would be?

Moreover, if Lin Yuan grasped the Rule of Time at the Ninth Rank, he would enjoy the Chaos Void’s gifts even sooner.

“The origin bestowed by the Chaos Void will greatly stabilize the inner world and elevate its essence, transitioning towards an inner universe.”

“Of course, even if you do comprehend the Rule of Time, rendering the inner world independent, the challenge of breaking through to Tier 11, due to your own realm and strength, won’t allow for a full transformation of the inner world into an inner universe all at once.”

“But with this foundation and core in place, future breakthrough to the Ultimate will be notably less challenging,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being said slowly.

This is akin to distributing the future pressure of striving for the Ultimate into the present, enhancing the likelihood of stepping into the Twelfth Rank.

So far, Lin Yuan had only heard of two methods that could increase the odds of striving for the Ultimate.

One is to spread the path of his own evolution.

The other is to Enlighten Chaos Rules.

As for the fusion of time and space rules? That’s a prerequisite for striving for the Ultimate.

Without achieving the Fusion of Time and Space, one can’t even step over the threshold of striving for the Ultimate.

“Xia Qin Supreme Being, actually, I might not be able to comprehend the Rule of Time at the Ninth Rank,” Lin Yuan said after contemplation.

With his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, coupled with treasures like the Miniature Universe for comprehension, Lin Yuan was somewhat confident in comprehending the Rule of Time at the Ninth Rank.

But confident? Not so much.

Lin Yuan had even prepared himself to comprehend the Rule of Time at the Tenth Rank.

It’s important to know that… comprehending the Rule of Time is even harder than advancing to Tier 11.

Many Eleventh-Rank Evolvers haven’t comprehended the Rule of Time.

Lin Yuan wanting to grasp the Rule of Time at the Ninth Rank was nothing he could guarantee.

What if he failed? Wouldn’t that be a slap to his own face?

“I know you’re unsure about comprehending it,” Xia Qin Supreme Being didn’t seem surprised at all.

Unless they are Innate Temporal Beings, who can guarantee they can definitely grasp the Rule of Time?

“That’s why I asked you to work out all the rule models of time before coming to me, aside from gauging your general perception of time, it was to give you a push,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan with a smile.

“A push?” Lin Yuan was momentarily stunned.

Understanding the Rule of Time is an extremely personal matter.

Everyone’s understanding of the Rule of Time differs, and it’s not something that can be forcefully taught.

Even miraculous items like the Miniature Universe can only reduce the difficulty Lin Yuan faces in perceiving the Rule of Time.

As for giving a push? Lin Yuan had never before considered this possibility.

The many treasures and methods left by The Demonic Jade Tower Master and Xuanhuang had never mentioned pushing someone to comprehend the Rule of Time.

“Yes.”

“Next, I’m going to take you to see…”

Xia Qin Supreme Being spoke calmly:

“the full extent of the River of Time.”
